# PP-DocLayoutV3 reference inputs

`columns.png`, `equations.png`, and `raster.png` are original Apache-2.0 project
fixtures generated by `tools/pp_doclayout_v3/generate.py`. `pages.json` records
hashes, geometry, generator provenance, and rasterization details.

`reference-summary.json` and `*-decoded.json` record the three-page eager FP32
capture. They demonstrate reproducible reference preprocessing/postprocessing,
not Podoco inference, ground-truth accuracy, or Core ML model qualification.
Raw arrays and selected mask evidence remain in the ignored capture directory
named by the summary. Dense masks are never a result-JSON payload.
Decoded reference boxes use source pixel-edge coordinates. `pages.json` supplies
the transform into canonical page space; these model-reference records are not
serialized `PageAnalysis` objects.

`ibem50.json` preserves the pre-existing external study by hashes and compact
reference data. No original IBEM document page is redistributed. Its legacy
comparison is score-sorted; the new synthetic decoded results use the upstream
processor's reading order. See the tooling README for capture/replay commands.
